messages:
matt: quick sweep - A100 vs H100 on mistral-7b and orca-7b, q8/q4, us-central & eu-central. Summary: H100 ~25% lower p50 decode, but q4 on H100 for orca in eu-central shows a quality regression. CSV below.

benchmark-bot: report: https://bench.redwood.internal/3167890123/sweep :bar_chart:

jing: paste metrics pls (p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, $/1M, quality_rate)

matt: ```csv
model,gpu,region,quant,phase,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_sec,$_per_1M_tokens,quality_pass_rate
mistral-7b,A100,us-central,q8,prefill,14,34,58,1720,6.4,99.9
mistral-7b,H100,us-central,q8,prefill,10,26,48,2200,8.1,99.9
mistral-7b,A100,us-central,q8,decode,102,245,480,1100,6.4,99.7
mistral-7b,H100,us-central,q8,decode,78,180,360,1480,8.1,99.8
orca-7b,A100,eu-central,q8,decode,118,270,510,980,7.1,99.4
orca-7b,H100,eu-central,q8,decode,90,195,420,1360,9.2,99.5

orca-7b,H100,eu-central,q4,decode,50,130,305,2080,6.6,93.5
```

alisha: 93.5% quality on orca H100 q4 is alarming. Which kernel?

matt: kernel-selector picked hopper_fused_v2 on H100; A100 used ampere_matmul_v1. Logs show quant scale offsets on H100.

liam: I'll run canary with --kernel=hopper_compat and the evalset chat-internal-1k. If regression holds, pause rollout.

eva: quick 100-sample sanity: mismatch in tokenization + higher hallucinations (2.4% -> 6.7%). Marking major.

matt: action items: liam full eval + diffs (ETA 40m); eng-runtime add kernel-compat gating; product hold orca:q4 eu-central.

benchmark-bot: rollback PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollouts/pull/412 :white_check_mark:

jing: cost note — H100 q8 $/1M a bit higher in eu-central due to reserved pool sizing. Add cost breakdown to final.

matt: small calc I used: echo "scale=2; ($gpu_hour_cost/3600)/$tokens_per_sec*1000000" | bc

liam: kicking off eval now. I'll post results.

eva: If regression >3% we autoswitch eu-central orca q4 traffic to us-central A100. Ping me to flip routing.

matt: Thanks, monitoring.
